hero.title: Hi, I'm Lauana, a <hl>UX Designer</hl>.
hero.text: I've lived in Ireland for 2 years and I'm focused on UX Design. I love the design world and have been specializing in it through research, wireframes and Figma prototypes.
hero.photoAlt: Lauana smiling, wearing glasses and a denim jacket, in front of a canal

about.label: 01 · About
about.title: A little about me
paragraphs: I'm a UX Designer focused on intuitive interfaces and user-centered digital experiences, making the interaction between people and technology easier.
Right now I'm sharpening my skills in user research, prototyping, wireframing and interface design, aiming to turn ideas into functional, accessible projects.
I'm looking for a UX Design opportunity where I can contribute, learn from other professionals and grow with the team.

cards.title: Intuitive
cards.text: Interfaces that are simple to understand and use.

cards.title: User-centered
cards.text: I start from research and usability testing with the people who will use it.

cards.title: Functional and accessible
cards.text: Projects that work on any screen and for as many people as possible.
